stop_procedure: Before concurrent launch, the operator must arm an external 7200-second process watchdog and observe request counts throughout. Stop new admissions at 1800 counted requests, reserving 200 for bounded independent read-only reconciliation. At a hard deadline, challenge, unavailable budget or unsafe service, stop all workers and broker and retain unknowns without additional requests. Interrupting an in-flight write makes it UNKNOWN, never dispatchable on restart. Cycle limits are additional bounds, not a substitute for the watchdog or request supervisor. Do not run a separate bulk-relist worker alongside maintenance.
